description: memo ambient memory hooks — proactive recall on every UserPromptSubmit, passive auto-capture on Stop, prewarm on SessionStart for fast cold-load, session snapshots so closed/crashed sessions can be resumed, and El Briefing (open loops + memory of the day) at startup. Every command is prefixed with MEMO_NONINTERACTIVE=1 so the first-run picker never fires inside a hook.

hooks.comment: Cross-Mac git pull + signal merge + reindex (F5). --quiet soft-fails (exit 0) when the memorias dir isn't a git clone, so non-synced installs are unaffected. Async so startup isn't blocked.
Synthesize the previous session into durable memorias before briefing. --if-due skips if already done. Runs async so startup isn't blocked.
Daily corpus freshness (archive-only, reversible). No-op unless >24h since last run; spawns detached so it never blocks startup. Disable with MEMO_MAINTAIN_DISABLE=1.

hooks.command: MEMO_NONINTERACTIVE=1 MEMO_CONTEXTUAL_RETRIEVAL=1 MEMO_RECALL_MIN_SIM=0.72 MEMO_RECALL_TOKEN_BUDGET=160 MEMO_RECALL_TOP_K=1 MEMO_RECALL_FEEDBACK_HINT=0 memo recall-hook
hooks.comment: Increased from 8s: daemon cold-start ~2s + inference ~3s + margin. MEMO_RECALL_MIN_SIM=0.72 chosen by `memo eval recall` (config B vec/0.72): same precision@5 as 0.60 with zero noise + 47ms p50.
Increased from 3s: DB writes can be slow on first call

Idle capture: waits for a quiet window (MEMO_SESSION_IDLE_CAPTURE_SECS, default 10s) after the turn finishes and then mines the current session chunk into durable memorias. Stale workers self-cancel if a newer prompt updated the session snapshot. Async + soft-fail so it never touches the recall 5s budget. Disable with MEMO_CAPTURE_DISABLE=1.

Durable in-session GitHub sync: self-throttled (MEMO_SYNC_PUSH_DEBOUNCE_S / MEMO_SYNC_PULL_INTERVAL_S) so a crashed/long session doesn't strand hours of memorias until Stop, and a long session converges on another Mac's pushes without a restart. Cheap no-op (timestamp check, no git) when not due; soft no-ops on non-git installs. Async so it never touches the recall 5s budget. Disable with MEMO_SYNC_AUTO=0.

Final flush via the single lock-guarded machine coordinator (pull-rebase-before-push). Listed last so this session's capture-stop write is on disk first. Lock-guarded so it never races the per-prompt `sync auto` or a sibling session. --quiet soft no-ops on local-tier (no remote) installs.

Longer idle consolidation: waits for a longer quiet window (MEMO_SESSION_IDLE_REFLECT_SECS, default 5m) after the turn finishes and then synthesizes the active session into a durable arc note. Stale workers self-cancel if a newer prompt updated the session snapshot. Async + soft-fail so it never touches the recall 5s budget. Disable with MEMO_CAPTURE_DISABLE=1.

Daily body compression: LLM-compresses memorias > 2000 chars to 2-3 sentences (MEMO_DREAM_COMPRESS_THRESHOLD). Shorter stored bodies → more signal-dense recall injections. No-op unless > 24h since last dream run. Async + soft-fail.
